EmailTemplate.description: For use by the Admission Services App Services team
EmailTemplate.name: Transfer Credit Inquiry (Student - Transferred)
EmailTemplate.subject: Transfer credit issue update
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Arizona State University’s Admission Services about your transfer credits. We’ve confirmed that the transfer credits are displaying correctly in our system and transferred this case to another department for review.
If you have any questions about the status of your transfer credit issue, please contact the advising office for your major. View major maps and advising contact information for your degree program at https://asu.edu/degrees.
Thank you,
Admission Services transfercredit@asu.edu
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
